scope: local only, shared development host, no online deployment

specials.failureReason: 并发收藏应全部幂等成功
specials.uncertainWrites: HTTP超时/连接错误时需人工核对；不自动重试

batches.latencyNote: GET耗时为读取完整内容，未单独测量首字节

batches.adjustmentReason: 单IP每60秒30次签票，100线程不能取得100张有效票据
batches.note: 短时预签票GET，不代表持续完整下载业务容量

specials.transport: Python urllib短批，无连接池/无keepalive；不是JMeter五分钟稳态容量

configuration.adjustmentReason: 10MiB上传使用urllib整包缓冲，同机100并发会产生多份百MiB/ GiB级缓冲，降为10线程20请求

coldCache.note: 只验证返回与回填TTL，不声称SQL只执行一次

soak-mixed-c100.user-stop.json.reason: 不需要测试连续稳定性，继续后续测试

final-runtime-reconciliation.json.statisticsMeaning: Counted at successful signing stage; not equal to complete GET count

gcSummary.scope: Only completed measured JMeter windows; not a memory-leak proof
